subject: Please pause trial countdown — PO & vendor security review in progress
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha@carewell.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@carewell.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Trial window & procurement status — need short pause?

Hi Irene,

Quick update from procurement: our vendor-security team flagged a dependency in the integration checklist and paused PO approval while they validate the external vendor questionnaire. Finance says the PO is in the final queue but it could be another 7–12 business days depending on the compliance team.

We really want to keep the sandbox active for the week-of-demo next month — would Redwood be willing to pause the trial countdown or provide a small interim token allotment while the security review completes? Attaching the questionnaire and a screenshot of the PO staging page for context.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 1 page), po_status_screenshot.png (PNG)

Thanks for any help you can provide — this pilot is high-priority for us.

Samantha Green
Senior Product Manager, CareWell Health
S: (415) 555-0127

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@carewell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial window & procurement status — need short pause?

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear update and the attachments, that helps. Two practical options we can offer quickly while the PO is moving through your security queue:

1) Temporary trial freeze for 72 hours (stops the countdown on your current sandbox timer so you don’t lose progress).
2) One-time interim token top-up (5,000 tokens) to keep tests running while procurement finishes.

If you prefer the freeze, we’ll need a quick confirmation here from your side and an approximate PO ETA so we can track. If you want the token top-up, Karthik (copied) will route the promo approval internally this afternoon.

I’ll also flag this with our billing/finance touchpoint in case they need to reconcile once the PO arrives.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: CareWell token top-up / freeze approval request

Irene — looping you and Marissa as requested.

Internal note: CareWell (deal CW-2027-Q4-98) needs a short runway while vendor security finishes validation. Customer provided questionnaire and PO staging screenshot — attached in the thread.

Recommendation: approve the 72-hour trial freeze as a low-risk alleviation (no billing changes; we simply pause countdown). If the customer asks for tokens instead, approve a one-time 5k token grant (promotional budget). Either option is reversible once PO is received.

Marissa — can you confirm promotional budget for a 5k token top-up if they select that path? If not, we’ll proceed with the freeze and document in HubSpot.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Samantha Green <samantha@carewell.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@carewell.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial window & procurement status — need short pause?

Irene — appreciate the quick options. We’ll take the 72-hour trial freeze to keep the environment stable while security validates the questionnaire. PO ETA from finance is ~10 business days (they're prioritizing but need the security sign-off first).

Please go ahead and pause the timer today; we’ll follow up with the PO and confirm once it’s routed. If anything changes and the PO lands earlier, we’ll notify you immediately.

Thanks again for moving quickly on this — it keeps our demo schedule intact.

Samantha
Senior Product Manager, CareWell Health
